newsitem.title: ITALY: Technical hitch blocks Milan bourse screen prices.
newsitem.headline: Technical hitch blocks Milan bourse screen prices.

text.p: A technical hitch at the Milan bourse data processing centre has blocked share price and volume data on many terminal screens, the stock market authority said.
But screens in equity dealing rooms, which have a different circuit linked to the bourse computer centre, were working normally.
Further details will be announced as soon as possible.
